text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Would y'all mind gatherin' up for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
集まってもらえます～？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: What's up, Princess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ、
姫さん？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Are we all gonna dance together?
text_block_list.orig_text: もしかして一緒に踊るさ～？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hm? Didn't realize you were here too, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　なんだ、
{0}も来てたのかよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Now we really gotta dance! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: これはますます踊らにゃ損さ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Woo! ♪
Makoto can play some music for us! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったさ～♪
じゃあ、演奏はマコトに任せるさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: No chance that's happening!
text_block_list.orig_text: いや演奏しねぇよ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Where'd that come from?!
Are you for real? Then, uh, guess we might as well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
なんでだ！？
本気か？
　えっと、
じゃあ、
仕方ないけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'll play some music for you, then! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ私は演奏するさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes.
Dancing's all well and good, but there's somethin'
I'd like to give y'all first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい。
踊るのもええけど、
その前に
みんなに渡したいもんがあるんよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Something you'd like to give us?
text_block_list.orig_text: 渡したいもの？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye. I caused a whole lot of trouble for y'all, didn't I?
So I figured I'd repay y'all.
Not just for that, but for everything else as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そや。
ほら、
こないだは
迷惑かけたやろ？
だから、
日ごろの感謝も兼ねて、
うちからのお礼や。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... Is this a plushie of me?
It's super cu— Err, it's super well made!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお……
これ、
あたしのぬいぐるみか？
すっげぇかわ、
いや、
よく出来てるな……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I'm so happy!
You really are good at making stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でーじうれしいさ～！
　マホは器用だね～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Glad y'all like them.
Kasumi was over the moon, too.
Sure was worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
喜んでもらえたみたいでうれしいなぁ。
カスミはんも喜んでくれたはったし、
作ってよかったわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to go out of your way, though.
It's not like we did anything special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもいいのかよ？
　こんなのもらっちまって。
あたしらは別に……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: We just followed our hearts. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 好きでやったことだしねぇ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
This is my way of conveying my feels.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええんよ。
これは
うちからの想いなんやから。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Your feelings?
text_block_list.orig_text: 想い？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye.
My way of sayin' that y'all are precious to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうや。
みんなが大切やいう、
うちの想いなんよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Maho!
Now we really gotta dance!
Come on, Makoto!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうさ～マホ～！
やっぱり踊るさ～、
マコトも一緒に、
ほら～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey, quit tugging!
Fine, fine! I get it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
やめろ引っ張んな！
分かった、
分かったから！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Heehee.
Oh, my prince.
Terribly sorry for the wait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
あ、
王子はん。
待たせてしもうて、
堪忍な。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: This li'l one's for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
王子はんの分の
ぬいぐるみや。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: That, plus...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それと……
もう一つ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Would you mind takin' this, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これも、
もらってくれますやろか。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: It's a plushie of me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちの、
ぬいぐるみなんやけど。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't mind takin' care of it myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分で大切にするんも
いいんやけれどもな？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
But, well.
I'd be mighty happy if someone else cherished it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもやっぱり、
誰かに、
大切にしてほしいんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself, right? That feelings don't go unfulfilled.
I'm sure both myself and this plushie would be
real happy if you cherished it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってほら、
想いは届く、
やろ？
王子はんが大切にしてくれたら、
うちも、この子も、
うれしいなぁ
って、
思うんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Can I leave it in your care?
text_block_list.orig_text:
貰って、
くれます？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Thanks, my prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
王子はん。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Should it ever come to have a benevolent soul,
I'm sure it'll keep you safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつかその子に魂が宿ったら、
きっと
王子はんを守ってくれはりますよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What about a plushie for myself?
Don't worry. I've already got everyone here. That, plus—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　うちの分のぬいぐるみ？
それなら、
なんも問題あらへんよ。
うちには
このお城のみんながおるし──

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I've always entrusted you with the duty of protecting me. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちを守ってくれる役は、
王子はんがやってくれますやろ……♪
